mapper.select: SELECT PLAN_ID AS planId, PLAN_NAME AS planName, PRICE AS price, DESCRIPTION AS description, BILLING_CYCLE AS billingCycle, MAX_MEMBER_COUNT AS maxMemberCount FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS WHERE DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY PRICE ASC

SELECT PLAN_ID AS planId, PLAN_NAME AS planName, PRICE AS price, DESCRIPTION AS description, BILLING_CYCLE AS billingCycle, MAX_MEMBER_COUNT AS maxMemberCount FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.sql: U.UNIV_ID AS univId, U.UNIV_NAME AS univName, U.SIDO AS sido, U.ADDRESS AS address, U.SCHOOL_PHONE AS schoolPhone, U.HOMEPAGE AS homepage, CASE WHEN S.STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 'PENDING' WHEN S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT ( NVL(S.PENDING_ACTION, 'NONE') = 'CANCEL' AND NVL( S.CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59' ) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE S.STATUS END AS subscriptionStatus

FROM UNIVERSITY U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT S.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY S.UNIV_ID ORDER BY S.STARTED_AT DESC, S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S WHERE S.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL ) S ON S.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID AND S.RN = 1
mapper.select:
SELECT
LOWER(U.UNIV_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'
ORDER BY U.UNIV_NAME ASC

WITH LATEST_SUBSCRIPTION AS ( SELECT S.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY S.UNIV_ID ORDER BY S.STARTED_AT DESC, S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S WHERE S.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL ) SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.ROLE, M.UNIV_ID, U.UNIV_NAME, U.SIDO, U.ADDRESS, U.SCHOOL_PHONE, U.HOMEPAGE, S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID, S.STATUS AS SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, S.PENDING_ACTION, S.CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT, S.ENDED_AT, S.NEXT_BILLING_AT, CASE WHEN S.PENDING_ACTION = 'PLAN_CHANGE' THEN ( SELECT H.PLAN_NAME FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AND H.STATUS = 'READY' ORDER BY H.HISTORY_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) END AS PENDING_PLAN_NAME, P.PLAN_ID, P.PLAN_NAME, P.PRICE, P.BILLING_CYCLE FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN LATEST_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID AND S.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_UNIVERSITY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO UNIVERSITY ( UNIV_ID, UNIV_NAME, SIDO, ADDRESS, SCHOOL_PHONE, HOMEPAGE ) VALUES ( #{univId}, #{univName}, #{sido}, #{address}, #{schoolPhone}, #{homepage} )

SELECT SEQ_SUBSCRIPTIONS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTIONS ( SUBSCRIPTION_ID, PLAN_ID, BILLINGKEY_ID, MEMBER_ID, UNIV_ID, STARTED_AT, NEXT_BILLING_AT, STATUS, ENDED_AT ) VALUES ( #{subscriptionId}, #{planId}, #{billingKeyId}, #{memberId}, #{univId}, #{startedAt}, #{nextBillingAt}, #{status}, #{endedAt} )

SELECT SEQ_SUBSCRIPTION_APPLICATIONS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION_APPLICATIONS ( APPLICATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, PLAN_ID, UNIV_NAME, SIDO, ADDRESS, SCHOOL_PHONE, HOMEPAGE, STATUS, CREATED_AT, COMPLETED_AT, CANCELED_AT, FAILED_AT, FAIL_REASON ) VALUES ( #{applicationId}, #{memberId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{planId}, #{univName}, #{sido}, #{address}, #{schoolPhone}, #{homepage}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL )

SELECT SEQ_SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES ( HISTORY_ID, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, UNIV_ID, MEMBER_ID, BILLINGKEY_ID, STATUS, MERCHANT_UID, PORTONE_PAYMENT_ID, PAID_AT, FAIL_REASON, AMOUNT, PLAN_NAME, PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID ) VALUES ( #{historyId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{univId}, #{memberId}, #{billingKeyId}, #{status}, #{merchantUid}, #{portonePaymentId}, #{paidAt}, #{failReason}, #{amount}, #{planName}, #{portoneScheduleId} )

SELECT SEQ_SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY ( SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_ID, SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_VALUE, MEMBER_ID, UNIV_ID, PG_PROVIDER, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{billingKeyId}, #{billingKeyValue}, #{memberId}, #{univId}, #{pgProvider}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_ID AS billingKeyId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, UNIV_ID AS univId, SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_VALUE AS billingKeyValue, PG_PROVIDER AS pgProvider, STATUS AS status FROM SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT H.HISTORY_ID AS historyId, COALESCE(H.PLAN_NAME, P.PLAN_NAME) AS planName, P.BILLING_CYCLE AS billingCycle, H.AMOUNT AS amount, H.STATUS AS status, CASE WHEN LOWER(B.PG_PROVIDER) = 'kakaopay' THEN 'KAKAO_PAY' ELSE 'CARD' END AS paymentMethod, CASE WHEN H.MERCHANT_UID LIKE 'sub_renew_%' THEN 'RECURRING' ELSE 'INITIAL' END AS paymentType, H.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, H.PAID_AT AS paidAt, H.FAIL_REASON AS failReason, S.NEXT_BILLING_AT AS nextBillingAt, H.REFUNDED_AT AS refundedAt, H.REFUND_AMOUNT AS refundAmount FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H JOIN SUBSCRIPTIONS S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY B ON B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_ID = H.BILLINGKEY_ID WHERE S.UNIV_ID = #{univId} ORDER BY H.CREATED_AT DESC, H.HISTORY_ID DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY SET SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_VALUE = #{billingKeyValue}, UNIV_ID = #{univId}, PG_PROVIDER = #{pgProvider}, STATUS = #{status}, DELETED_AT = NULL, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_ID = #{billingKeyId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND ENDED_AT IS NULL AND ( STATUS = 'PENDING' OR ( STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT ( NVL(PENDING_ACTION, 'NONE') = 'CANCEL' AND NVL( CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59' ) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS WHERE UNIV_ID = #{univId} AND ENDED_AT IS NULL AND ( STATUS = 'PENDING' OR ( STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT ( NVL(PENDING_ACTION, 'NONE') = 'CANCEL' AND NVL( CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59' ) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = S.UNIV_ID WHERE U.UNIV_NAME = #{univName} AND S.ENDED_AT IS NULL AND ( S.STATUS = 'PENDING' OR ( S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT ( NVL(S.PENDING_ACTION, 'NONE') = 'CANCEL' AND NVL( S.CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59' ) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUBSCRIPTION_APPLICATIONS WHERE UNIV_NAME = #{univName} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'

SELECT H.HISTORY_ID AS paymentHistoryId, H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AS subscriptionId, H.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, A.APPLICATION_ID AS applicationId, A.MEMBER_ID AS applicationMemberId, A.PLAN_ID AS applicationPlanId, H.UNIV_ID AS univId, S.PLAN_ID AS planId, P.PLAN_NAME AS planName, P.BILLING_CYCLE AS billingCycle, H.MERCHANT_UID AS merchantUid, H.AMOUNT AS amount, H.STATUS AS paymentStatus, S.STATUS AS subscriptionStatus, A.STATUS AS applicationStatus, A.UNIV_NAME AS univName, A.SIDO AS sido, A.ADDRESS AS address, A.SCHOOL_PHONE AS schoolPhone, A.HOMEPAGE AS homepage FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H JOIN SUBSCRIPTIONS S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_APPLICATIONS A ON A.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID WHERE H.MERCHANT_UID = #{merchantUid}

SELECT H.HISTORY_ID AS paymentHistoryId, H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AS subscriptionId, H.BILLINGKEY_ID AS billingKeyId, H.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, H.UNIV_ID AS univId, H.AMOUNT AS amount, H.MERCHANT_UID AS merchantUid, H.STATUS AS paymentStatus, S.STATUS AS subscriptionStatus, B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_VALUE AS portoneBillingKey, B.STATUS AS billingKeyStatus, P.PLAN_NAME AS planName, P.BILLING_CYCLE AS billingCycle FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H JOIN SUBSCRIPTIONS S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY B ON B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_ID = H.BILLINGKEY_ID JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID WHERE H.MERCHANT_UID = #{merchantUid} AND H.MERCHANT_UID LIKE 'sub_renew_%'
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES SET STATUS = 'PAID', PORTONE_PAYMENT_ID = #{portonePaymentId}, PAID_AT = #{paidAt}, UNIV_ID = #{univId}, FAIL_REASON = NULL WHERE HISTORY_ID = #{historyId} AND STATUS = 'READY'
UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES SET STATUS = 'PAID', PORTONE_PAYMENT_ID = #{portonePaymentId}, PAID_AT = #{paidAt}, FAIL_REASON = NULL WHERE HISTORY_ID = #{historyId} AND STATUS = 'READY'

UPDATE SUBSCRIPTIONS SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', NEXT_BILLING_AT = #{nextBillingAt}, PLAN_ID = NVL( ( SELECT PLAN_ID FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS WHERE PLAN_NAME = #{planName} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL ), PLAN_ID ), PENDING_ACTION = CASE WHEN PENDING_ACTION = 'PLAN_CHANGE' THEN NULL ELSE PENDING_ACTION END, PENDING_ACTION_AT = CASE WHEN PENDING_ACTION = 'PLAN_CHANGE' THEN NULL ELSE PENDING_ACTION_AT END WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID = #{subscriptionId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE SUBSCRIPTIONS SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', UNIV_ID = #{univId}, NEXT_BILLING_AT = #{nextBillingAt} WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID = #{subscriptionId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_APPLICATIONS SET STATUS = 'COMPLETED', COMPLETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FAIL_REASON = NULL WHERE APPLICATION_ID = #{applicationId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE SUBSCRIPTIONS SET STATUS = 'CANCELED', ENDED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID = #{subscriptionId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE MEMBER SET UNIV_ID = #{univId}, ROLE = 'ADM' WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.select: WITH READY_PAYMENTS AS ( SELECT H.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID ORDER BY H.HISTORY_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.STATUS = 'READY' ) SELECT S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID, S.UNIV_ID, S.MEMBER_ID, S.BILLINGKEY_ID, B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_VALUE AS PORTONE_BILLING_KEY, S.PLAN_ID, P.PLAN_NAME, P.PRICE AS PLAN_PRICE, S.STATUS AS SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, S.NEXT_BILLING_AT, S.PENDING_ACTION, H.HISTORY_ID AS READY_HISTORY_ID, H.MERCHANT_UID AS READY_MERCHANT_UID, H.PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID AS READY_SCHEDULE_ID, H.AMOUNT AS READY_AMOUNT FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY B ON B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_ID = S.BILLINGKEY_ID LEFT JOIN READY_PAYMENTS H ON H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AND H.RN = 1 WHERE S.UNIV_ID = #{univId} AND S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND S.ENDED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY S.STARTED_AT DESC, S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTIONS SET PENDING_ACTION = 'PLAN_CHANGE', PENDING_ACTION_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT = NULL WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID = #{subscriptionId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ENDED_AT IS NULL AND NVL(PENDING_ACTION, 'NONE') != 'CANCEL'

UPDATE SUBSCRIPTIONS SET PENDING_ACTION = 'CANCEL', PENDING_ACTION_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT = NEXT_BILLING_AT WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID = #{subscriptionId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ENDED_AT IS NULL AND NEXT_BILLING_AT IS NOT NULL AND NVL(PENDING_ACTION, 'NONE') != 'CANCEL'

UPDATE SUBSCRIPTIONS SET PENDING_ACTION = NULL, PENDING_ACTION_AT = NULL, CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT = NULL WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID = #{subscriptionId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND PENDING_ACTION = 'CANCEL'

UPDATE SUBSCRIPTIONS SET PENDING_ACTION = NULL, PENDING_ACTION_AT = NULL, CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT = NULL WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID = #{subscriptionId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND PENDING_ACTION = 'PLAN_CHANGE'
UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES SET MERCHANT_UID = #{merchantUid}, PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID = #{portoneScheduleId}, FAIL_REASON = NULL WHERE HISTORY_ID = #{historyId} AND STATUS = 'READY'
